name: auto-deploy-reo
description: Automated REO Dashboard deployment with testing and rollback

# Generated by Claude Code
# Version: 1.0.0

parameters:
  branch:
    description: "Branch to deploy (default: main)"
    required: false
    default: "main"

  run_tests:
    description: "Run comprehensive functional tests before reporting success"
    type: boolean
    default: true

  auto_merge:
    description: "Automatically merge to main after successful tests"
    type: boolean
    default: true

  force_deploy:
    description: "Skip tests and deploy immediately"
    type: boolean
    default: false

# Environment configuration
env:
  PRODUCTION_URL: "https://hub.thegraph.foundation/reo/"
  INFRASTRUCTURE_DIR: "/home/pdiogo/hosted-apps/repos/dashboard-infrastructure"
  DOCKER_IMAGE: "ghcr.io/graphprotocol/rewards-eligibility-oracle-dashboard:latest"
  REO_CONTAINER: "reo-scheduler-prod"
  CADDY_CONTAINER: "dashboards-caddy"

# Paths
paths:
  repo:
    description: "Path to REO repository"
    required: true
    default: "/home/pdiogo/hosted-apps/repos/rewards-eligibility-oracle-dashboard"

# Helper functions
helpers:
  - name: wait_for_github_actions
    description: "Wait for GitHub Actions workflow to complete after pushing to main"
    arguments:
      branch:
        description: "Branch to wait for"
        required: true
      max_wait:
        description: "Maximum wait time in seconds (default: 300)"
        type: integer
        default: 300
    command: |
      gh run list --branch "${branch}" --limit 1 --json status,conclusion,createdAt,displayTitle
      return_code=$?

  - name: pull_docker_image
    description: "Pull latest Docker image from GHCR"
    arguments:
      force:
        description: "Force pull even if image is up to date"
        type: boolean
        default: false
    command: |
      cd "${INFRASTRUCTURE_DIR}"
      docker pull "${DOCKER_IMAGE}:latest" 2>&1
      echo "✅ Docker image pulled"

  - name: restart_containers
    description: "Restart REO containers with new image"
    arguments:
      force:
        description: "Force restart even if containers are running"
        type: boolean
        default: false
    command: |
      cd "${INFRASTRUCTURE_DIR}"
      docker compose up -d --force-recreate ${REO_CONTAINER} ${CADDY_CONTAINER} 2>&1
      echo "✅ REO containers restarted"

  - name: wait_for_dashboard
    description: "Wait for dashboard to be regenerated by scheduler"
    arguments:
      max_wait:
        description: "Maximum wait time in seconds (default: 90)"
        type: integer
        default: 90
    command: |
      sleep 10
      max_wait=${max_wait}
      echo "⏳ Waiting for dashboard regeneration..."

  - name: run_functional_tests
    description: "Run comprehensive functional tests using Playwright"
    arguments:
      save_results:
        description: "Path to save test results JSON"
        type: string
        default: "/tmp/test_results.json"
    command: |
      python3 << 'EOF'
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

def log_test(name, passed, details=""):
    result = {"name": name, "passed": passed, "details": details}
    print(json.dumps(result))
    return result

def run_tests():
    results = []

    with sync_playwright() as p:
        browser = p.chromium.launch(headless=True)
        page = browser.new_page()

        try:
            # Test 1: Page loads
            log_test("Page Load", True, "Page loaded successfully")

            page.goto("${PRODUCTION_URL}")
            page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")

            # Test 2: Check for streak cells
            page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
            streak_cells = page.locator("td.streak-days").count()
            log_test("Streak Cells Visible", streak_cells > 0,
                    f"Found {streak_cells} streak cells")

            # Test 3: Get initial addresses
            def get_addresses():
                return [a[:20] for a in page.locator("tbody tr td:first-child a").all_text_contents()]

            initial_streak = get_addresses()
            log_test("Initial State", True,
                    f"First 5: {', '.join(initial_streak[:5])}")

            # Test 4: Click streak sort
            page.click("#sortStreakBtn")
            page.wait_for_timeout(1500)

            mode_after_click = page.evaluate("() => localStorage.getItem('sortMode')")
            is_active = "active" in (page.locator("#sortStreakBtn").get_attribute("class") or "")
            log_test("Streak Sort Click", mode_after_click == "streak" and is_active,
                    f"Sort mode: {mode_after_click}, Button active: {is_active}")

            streak_addrs = get_addresses()
            log_test("Streak Mode Order", True,
                    f"First 5: {', '.join(streak_addrs[:5])}")

            # Test 5: Click default sort
            page.click("#sortDefaultBtn")
            page.wait_for_timeout(1500)

            mode_after_click = page.evaluate("() => localStorage.getItem('sortMode')")
            log_test("Default Sort Click", mode_after_click == "default",
                    f"Sort mode: {mode_after_click}, First 5: {', '.join(get_addresses()[:5])}")

            # Test 6: Verify order changed
            order_changed = streak_addrs != get_addresses()
            log_test("Order Changes", order_changed,
                    f"Streak vs Default: {'DIFFERENT' if order_changed else 'IDENTICAL'}")

            # Test 7: Test filters
            page.click("#filterEligibleBtn")
            page.wait_for_timeout(500)

            eligible_count = page.locator("tbody tr").count()
            page.click("#resetFilterBtn")
            page.wait_for_timeout(500)

            reset_count = page.locator("tbody tr").count()
            log_test("Filter Function", eligible_count < 97 and reset_count == 97,
                    f"Eligible: {eligible_count}, Reset: {reset_count}")

            # Test 8: Check table data
            page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
            table_html = page.evaluate("() => document.querySelector('tbody') ? 'EXISTS' : 'MISSING'")
            row_count = page.locator("tbody tr").count()
            log_test("Table Data", table_html == "EXISTS" and row_count == 97,
                    f"Table: {table_html}, Rows: {row_count}")

            # Test 9: Check sort buttons
            sort_wrapper = page.evaluate("() => document.querySelector('.sort-wrapper') ? 'EXISTS' : 'MISSING'")
            streak_btn_exists = page.locator("#sortStreakBtn").count() > 0
            default_btn_exists = page.locator("#sortDefaultBtn").count() > 0
            log_test("Sort Buttons", sort_wrapper == "EXISTS" and streak_btn_exists and default_btn_exists,
                    f"Sort wrapper: {sort_wrapper}, Streak btn: {streak_btn_exists}, Default btn: {default_btn_exists}")

            # Test 10: Take screenshot
            page.screenshot(path="/tmp/deployment_screenshot.png")
            log_test("Screenshot", True, "Screenshot saved")

            browser.close()

        except Exception as e:
            log_test("Exception", False, str(e))

        all_passed = all(r["passed"] for r in results)
        total = len(results)
        passed = sum(1 for r in results if r["passed"] else 0)
        failed = total - passed

        # Save results
        import json
        with open("${save_results}", 'w') as f:
            json.dump({
                "all_passed": all_passed,
                "total": total,
                "passed": passed,
                "failed": failed,
                "timestamp": __import__('time').time().isoformat()
            })

        print("\n" + "=" * 60)
        print("📊 DEPLOYMENT TEST RESULTS")
        print("=" * 60)

        for r in results:
            status = "✓ PASS" if r["passed"] else "✗ FAIL"
            print(f"{status}: {r['name']}")
            print(f"         {r['details']}")

        print("=" * 60)
        print(f"Total Tests: {total}")
        print(f"Passed: {passed}")
        print(f"Failed: {failed}")

        if not all_passed:
            print("\n❌ SOME TESTS FAILED")
            return 1
        else:
            print("\n✅ ALL TESTS PASSED")
            print(f"\n🌐 Production URL: {PRODUCTION_URL}")
            return 0

# Main workflow
main:
  - name: Deploy to Production with Testing
    description: "Complete deployment workflow: GitHub Actions → Docker pull → Container restart → Tests → Report"

  - name: Deploy to Production (Skip Tests)
    description: "Deploy immediately without running tests"
    if: "${run_tests}" == "false"
    steps:
      - name: Wait for GitHub Actions
        run: wait_for_github_actions
          branch: ${branch}
          max_wait: 300

      - name: Pull Docker Image
        run: pull_docker_image

      - name: Restart Containers
        run: restart_containers

      - name: Wait for Dashboard
        run: wait_for_dashboard
          max_wait: 90

      - name: Run Functional Tests
        if: "${run_tests}" != "false"
        run: run_functional_tests
          save_results: ${save_results}

      - name: Report Results
        run: |
          python3 << 'EOF'
import json
import sys

with open("${save_results}") as f:
    data = json.load(f)
    all_passed = data.get("all_passed", False)
    total = data.get("total", 0)
    passed = data.get("passed", 0)
    failed = total - passed

    print("\n" + "=" * 60)
    print("================================================")
    print("  📊 DEPLOYMENT TEST RESULTS")
    print("=" * 60)

    if not all_passed:
        print(f"  ❌ TESTS FAILED: {failed}/{total} tests failed")
        print(f"\n🌐 Production URL: {PRODUCTION_URL}")
        sys.exit(1)
    else:
        print(f"  ✅ ALL {total} TESTS PASSED")
        print(f"\n🌐 Production URL: {PRODUCTION_URL}")
        sys.exit(0)

  - name: Quick Deploy
    description: "Quick deployment without full testing cycle"
    if: "${run_tests}" == "false"
    steps:
      - name: Pull and Deploy
        run: |
          pull_docker_image
          restart_containers
          sleep 15

      - name: Report Success
        run: |
          echo "✅ Deployed to production"
          echo "🌐 Production URL: ${PRODUCTION_URL}"

# Alternative workflow: Auto-Merge and Deploy
auto_merge:
  description: "Merge feature branch to main after successful deployment"
  if: "${auto_merge}" == "true"
  steps:
      - name: Run Tests and Merge
        run: |
          # Run full test suite
          if python3 /tmp/final_test.py; all_passed=$?

          if [ "$all_passed" == "1" ]; then
            gh pr merge feature/streak-sorting --merge --delete-branch
          else
            echo "⚠️  Tests failed - skipping merge"
